title: NEB Class 11 Physics — Dynamics — 2022
origin: curated NEB-pattern set filling the 2022 gap for class-11 dynamics

questions.solution:
First law: a body keeps its state of rest or uniform motion unless a net external force acts (law of inertia). Second law: $F = ma$ — net force equals rate of change of momentum. Third law: every action has an equal and opposite reaction.
Acceleration $a = F/m = 10/2 = 5\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$. Final velocity $v = u + at = 0 + 5\times3 = 15\,\mathrm{m/s}$, so momentum $p = mv = 2\times15 = 30\,\mathrm{kg\,m/s}$. Distance $s = ut + \tfrac{1}{2}at^2 = 0 + 0.5\times5\times9 = 22.5\,\mathrm{m}$.
questions.question: State Newton's three laws of motion. A $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ mass experiences a net force of $10\,\mathrm{N}$ for $3\,\mathrm{s}$ starting from rest. Find the final momentum and the distance travelled.

questions.solution:
Linear momentum $p = mv$. Principle: if no external force acts on a system, its total momentum stays constant.
Initially both at rest, so total momentum is 0. After the jump: $m_{\text{boy}}v_{\text{boy}} + m_{\text{boat}}v_{\text{boat}} = 0$.
$60\times3 + 120\times v_{\text{boat}} = 0$, so $v_{\text{boat}} = -180/120 = -1.5\,\mathrm{m/s}$ — the boat recoils at $1.5\,\mathrm{m/s}$ opposite to the jump.
questions.question: Define linear momentum and state the principle of conservation of linear momentum. A $60\,\mathrm{kg}$ boy jumps off a $120\,\mathrm{kg}$ stationary boat with velocity $3\,\mathrm{m/s}$. What is the boat's recoil velocity?

questions.solution: Impulse equals change in momentum: $F\Delta t = \Delta p = m(v - u) = 0.5\times(0 - 4) = -2\,\mathrm{N\,s}$. Hence $F = -2/0.1 = -20\,\mathrm{N}$ — the wall pushed back with $20\,\mathrm{N}$ on average.
questions.question: A $0.5\,\mathrm{kg}$ ball moving at $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ is stopped by a wall in $0.1\,\mathrm{s}$. What average force did the wall exert?
